evidence_summary: In BNL CL.2 mouse liver cells, recombinant mouse resistin changed insulin-resistance-related gene expression, and CAP1 siRNA altered the resistin-responsive gene program, including Jak2, Pik3r1, Socs3, Stat3, and related metabolic/inflammatory genes.
limitations: The study supports CAP1-dependent modulation of a resistin-responsive gene program, not direct mouse Retn-Cap1 binding, a purified receptor assay, TF activation, or a single linear pathway. Gene-expression changes are not equivalent to direct STAT3 or JAK2 activation. High is limited to the cited mouse downstream/function record; no direct binding, receptor-proximal relay, TF, or SCI inference is made.
